svg.title: Correlation changes the portfolio curve
svg.desc: Four exact two-asset curves for correlation 1, 0.2, 0 and -1. Asset A has mean 12% and SD 20%; B mean 6% and SD 10%.

g.text: Same assets, different co-movement. Each curve contains all long-only weights.
Hypothetical inputs | 1-year simple total returns | No market observations
